decisions.statement: A name is found by the typing rather than by matching the text of a body.
A name the body declares and exports nowhere is spelled anew over that body.
A body the rename would change and that reaches the new name already is refused.
A body naming no such name is left as that body is.
Nothing here says which paths the name is spelled over.

definition: the edits spelling a name one body exports anew over the paths handed in
